summary: Lower string.prototype.codepointat with exact JavaScript index and UTF-16 semantics.

target.notes: Return the UTF-16 encoded code point starting at a code-unit index; trailing surrogates stand alone; out of range is undefined.

semantics.encoding: combines a valid leading+trailing surrogate pair only when starting on the lead

tests.name: trail surrogate position
tests.expected_behavior: prints the trailing surrogate code unit value 56836
